description: Workspace identity of a project folder: format version, library uid, display name, and provenance. Not a node artifact — the root module node lives in module.json.

created.title: Provenance: ISO date the project was created

exports.description: Module folder names this project exports, for other projects to import. Only meaningful alongside a "pattern" or "rig" kind.
exports.title: Authored module export list

kind.description: General project (absent/"general"), or one of two library kinds ("pattern"/"rig") that export named modules via `exports`, or a "show" project. Never read by the engine — Studio-side lint and UI only.
kind.title: Authored project kind

target.description: A board catalog id in the registry's vendor/product vocabulary (e.g. espressif/esp32-c6-devkitc-1), the same strings as RegisteredDevice.board_id. Advisory only — the engine never reads it.
target.title: Advisory board target

version.title: Provenance: authored version string (no semver semantics yet)

title: LightPlayer project container manifest
